issues.desc: Background explains the Layer 3 formal-proof mechanics, but it does not state the user-recognizable completion outcome plainly enough. It should say that after this story the user can rely on a fresh formal verdict that unlocks only loopEngineeringClaim for the tested task classes, while higher claims remain locked.

Checklist items CHK-002 and CHK-005 are framed as internal validation work rather than user-observable outcomes. INIT is still executable, but the checklist should tie these steps to a visible acceptance result so the user can tell when the story is actually complete instead of only seeing infrastructure churn.
